_comment: Providers scripts/validate-provider-keys.py smoke-tests, moved out of the
script in #5029 so the default model per provider is data, not a literal.
label         Human name printed in the report.
base_url      OpenAI-compatible base. Overridable at runtime for ollama via
OPENAI_API_BASE (the house proxy), which is an env fact, not a
config fact, so it stays in code.
api_key_env   Preferred env var holding the key. ollama falls back to
OPENAI_API_KEY because CI maps secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY to it —
also env-dependent, so it stays in code.
model_env     Env var that overrides model_default for a one-off run.
model_default The model sent when model_env is unset. Any real model id here
must be servable by that provider's own endpoint.
required      True makes a missing key a hard failure. False means SKIP is
Note openrouter/auto is a router pseudo-model, not a real model id — the
OpenRouter router picks the backend, so it needs no catalog entry.
